description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the LoanReAgingValidator component in a loan management system. It validates different scenarios for loan re-aging, including input validation, business rules enforcement, and exception handling.

classes.name: LoanReAgingValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LoanReAgingValidator, verifying validation logic for loan re-aging scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes context before each test, setting tenant and business date context.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets context after each test.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldNotThrowException
methods.description: Verifies that valid re-age data does not trigger exceptions.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenExternalIdIsLongerThan100
methods.description: Checks that an external ID exceeding max length causes validation error.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenStartDateIsMissing
methods.description: Ensures missing start date triggers validation error.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenFrequencyTypeIsMissing
methods.description: Checks that missing frequency type results in validation error.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenFrequencyNumberIsMissing
methods.description: Checks validation errors for missing frequency number.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenFrequencyNumberIsZero
methods.description: Ensures frequency number must be greater than zero.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenNumberOfInstallmentsIsMissing
methods.description: Ensures number of installments must be provided.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenNumberOfInstallmentsIsZero
methods.description: Ensures number of installments must be greater than zero.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenNumberOfInstallmentsIsNegative
methods.description: Checks that negative installments trigger validation error.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsBeforeMaturity
methods.description: Validates that re-aging before maturity date is blocked.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenStartDateIsBeforeMaturity
methods.description: Ensures start date cannot be before maturity date.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsOnCumulativeSchedule
methods.description: Validates that only progressive schedule loans can be re-aged.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsNotOnAdvancedPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Checks that only certain schedule types permit re-aging.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsInterestBearing
methods.description: Ensures only non-interest-bearing loans are eligible for re-aging.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanIsNotActive
methods.description: Blocks re-aging of non-active loans.

methods.name: testValidateReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanAlreadyHasReAgeForToday
methods.description: Prevents multiple re-age transactions on the same day.

methods.name: testValidateUndoReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanDoesntHaveReAge
methods.description: Checks undo re-age when no prior re-age exists.

methods.name: testValidateUndoReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanAlreadyHasRepaymentAfterReAge
methods.description: Blocks undo re-age if repayments exist after re-aging.

methods.name: testValidateUndoReAge_ShouldThrowException_WhenLoanAlreadyHasRepaymentAfterReAge_SameDay
methods.description: Same as above but for transactions on the same day with different times.

methods.name: testValidateUndoReAge_ShouldNotThrowException_WhenLoanAlreadyHasRepaymentAfterReAge_SameDay_RepaymentBeforeReAge
methods.description: Allows undo re-age if repayment occurs before re-age transaction.
